questions.prompt: How should the code be organized for the hash map or set approach to Design HashMap?

choices.label: Store values by hash remainder without retaining full keys.
choices.feedback: Colliding keys would overwrite one another and queries could return the wrong value.

choices.label: Remove the first pair from the selected bucket.
choices.feedback: The matching full key may occur later among colliding entries.

choices.label: Always append a new pair when an existing key is updated.
choices.feedback: A later get could encounter the stale pair instead of the new value.

choices.label: Hash keys into buckets of key-value pairs. Update a matching pair, append a new key, and search or remove by the full key.
